run_make_minimal_ovr_sdk: run the script to generate a minimal Oculus SDK archive from the original SDK zip
extract_ovr_sdk_archive: extract the Oculus SDK zip archive into a directory for further processing
patch_vcxproj_crt_linking: patch the LibOVR.vcxproj file to link the CRT dynamically instead of statically
build_libovr_with_msbuild: build the libovr library in both Debug and Release configurations using msbuild
zip_minimal_ovr_sdk: zip the built libovr libraries, include headers, and license files into a minimal archive
